cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let's reassure the stallholders that the fair is still on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I have the right contact list. I'll say the arrangements are unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their arrangements changed because of you. Two vans are cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find replacements. Could your update call it a transport hiccup? They need something calm to read.

mechanism: A directs a calm fair update while suppressing how A panic triggered the cancellations, using organizer-like authority to repair and control the account.
confusable: D61 hides starting a problem generally; D109 specifically hides the contribution of A fear or resentment to an emotional spiral.
comparison: A forecast panic canceling transport differs from a tearful theft allegation spread to a committee.
seedUse: Use D109-a actual two canceled vans to force real replacement work instead of accepting A unchanged-arrangements claim.
